_help: Clarification Completeness Gate assessment. status: VERIFIED|AUTHORIZED_DECISION|SUPPORTED_INFERENCE|UNRESOLVED|NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION. Non-N/A statuses need refs (resolved Q- ids, existing C- ids). AUTHORIZED_DECISION must cite a question resolved by AUTHORIZED_DECISION. root_cause=VERIFIED requires understanding.root_cause.status=CONFIRMED. SUPPORTED_INFERENCE on expected_behavior/business_rules/acceptance_criteria is refused at high/critical risk.
